# Vendored browser libraries

The public page keeps these small, pinned libraries locally so its dialogs and content safety do not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- DOMPurify 3.4.13 — https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify — Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0
- a11y-dialog 8.1.5 — https://github.com/KittyGiraudel/a11y-dialog — MIT

License texts are stored in `vendor/licenses/`.
